artifact: 022-B3 ordinary main and mock process acceptance
scope: Dedicated PostgreSQL, isolated local payment sandbox, final embedded web bundle; no live PSP

database.name: moni_test
database.isolation: Three randomly named schemas, three NOLOGIN owners and five actual runtime LOGINs; original nonempty 019 manual funding retained before current migration upgrade
database.ordinary_main_instance_lock_window: Exclusively assigned by the root integrator; released after final cleanup

process_evidence.readiness: Ordinary main /health/ready and both mock listeners' real HTTP authorization refusals, with child exit observation
process_evidence.second_instance_refusal_reason: another active instance holds the service lock
process_evidence.authentication: Random offline QA users, bcrypt passwords, actual HTTP login cookie and CSRF token; no MFA binding or bypass endpoint
process_evidence.recovery: Real signed query and incoming capture evidence persisted; observed for three seconds with no provider mutation issuance and no processing of the pending capture into money; HTTP mutation rejected
process_evidence.provider_reply_loss: Mock was first stopped to produce a genuine network submission_unknown. After APP exited, a fault was armed for the original command. Recovery queried not_seen without issuing it. Sandbox then resumed the same command; provider committed and dropped the HTTP reply, and a signed query closed it. One provider command/order/transition and consumed fault were verified
process_evidence.query_replay: Replayed an actual APP worker child request twice against PSP; exact verified snapshot bytes and signatures remained valid
process_evidence.attested_off: An existing ready order captured while APP was stopped was credited by the attested off process; new orders were refused
process_evidence.ordinary_off: Without manifests, the actual isolated schema containing marker/history caused service construction refusal before listener/worker startup
process_evidence.shutdown_scope: Normal SIGTERM exited successfully, worker/projector connections reached zero, and confirmed funding identities survived restart. SIGKILL was applied only after confirmed commits
process_evidence.admission: Only definite 429 with Retry-After=1 was retried, using identical payload and original operation identifier

browser_evidence.credentials_source: Local 0600 temporary browser state, removed during final cleanup; no credential values retained in this evidence

mock and receiver manifests and secrets
